register_keypoint_metadata: register a KeypointMetadata named tuple with names, flip_map, and connection_rules in the KEYPOINT_METADATA_REGISTRY
get_keypoint_metadata: get keypoint metadata by name from the registry and return it as a dictionary
create_keypoint_metadata: create a KeypointMetadata named tuple with keypoint names, flip map pairs, and connection rules
convert_keypoint_metadata_to_dict: convert a KeypointMetadata instance to a dictionary with keypoint_names, keypoint_flip_map, and keypoint_connection_rules keys
review_keypoint_metadata_registry: review the KEYPOINT_METADATA_REGISTRY to see all registered keypoint metadata definitions
